name: Knott's Gourmet Churro Factory Bavarian Vanilla Cream Stuffed Churro
whyItWorks: Crispy fried churro filled with smooth Bavarian vanilla custard cream and dusted in cinnamon sugar. Seed-free and soothing vanilla filling.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bavarian Cream Churro warm (specifically avoid the seeded boysenberry stuffed churro).
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the Bavarian cream filling
